description: Data owned by a backend and cached on the client. Needs refetching, deduplication and invalidation. Best handled by query libraries.
State that only exists in the browser: UI flags, theme, cart, session details.
A value computed from other state or props. Compute it during render instead of storing it.
Moving state to the closest common parent so siblings can share it through props.
Passing props through components that do not use them. Often solved with composition before context.
State living outside React (Zustand, Redux, Jotai) that components subscribe to with selectors via `useSyncExternalStore`.
